spanish: y a abertura de tienda de reunión no lo trajere para acercar ofrenda a Jehová delante del tabernáculo de Jehová, sangre será contada al varón aquel; sangre derramó, y será cortado el varón aquel desde medio de su pueblo.

findings.issue: Hiphil perfect 3ms is rendered as future subjunctive; person, number, and causative bring-force remain, but the mood is prospective rather than perfect.
Construct משכן has no article token; “del” adds a Spanish article. Definiteness is only implied by the following proper name.

notes: Names, suffix, repetition, and both blood clauses stay within the tokens.
